source_changes: assemble_context_slice filters latest keys, file-hash-bound facts, task scope and status before reading eligible facts in bounded batches.
Each batch uses at most four independent CAS page reads and preserves newest-first output order.
A single page is capped at 2.4 KiB, aggregate inline values stay within the existing 8 KiB context budget, and short values leave budget for later facts.
The shared helper rejects preview requests above 64 KiB and deduplicates identical hash and page-size reads.
regression_test_source: shared_fact_context_parallel_reads_keep_newest_first_and_exact_byte_budget covers newest-first order, UTF-8-safe truncation and an exact 8192-byte aggregate value budget.
